newsitem.title: HONG KONG: ABN AMRO to launch HK fixed-rate mortgage.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO to launch HK fixed-rate mortgage.

text.p: ABN AMRO Bank said on Thursday it would launch a fixed interest home mortgage scheme in Hong Kong from Friday to the end of this year.
Borrowers should pay an annual fixed interest of nine percent for the first two years of the loan, and 0.5 percent on top of the local prime rate thereafter, it said in a statement.
Hong Kong's standard mortgage rate is 1.75 percentage points above prime rate, which currently stands at 8.5 percent.
But many banks in Hong Kong have cut mortgage rates to prime plus 0.5-1.00 point, or make their deals negotiable in the face of keen competition.
